findings.title: Self-improvement loop ledger produces duplicate epoch entries
findings.evidence: touched-files.jsonl lines 27-56: epoch 003 entries are fully duplicated (identical files, reasons, and epoch label). journal.md has two identical '## Epoch 003' sections. metrics.jsonl has two entries for epoch 003.
findings.suggested_fix: Add idempotency check in the self-improvement loop's verify/epoch wrap-up step: skip appending if an entry for the same epoch already exists in the ledger. Alternatively, fix the resume logic so it does not re-run the same epoch wrap-up.
findings.regression_check: After fix, run two consecutive epochs and verify no duplicate entries appear in journal.md, metrics.jsonl, or touched-files.jsonl
